actions.name: GLOBE Observer
actions.quote: A citizen science app allowing volunteers in GLOBE countries to take observations and contribute to the Global Learning and Observations to Benefit the Environment (GLOBE) community.

actions.name: Globe at Night
actions.quote: Globe at Night is an international citizen-science campaign to raise public awareness of the impact of light pollution by inviting citizen-scientists to measure and submit their night sky brightness observations.

actions.name: NASA citizen science
actions.quote: Through these projects, sometimes called citizen science or participatory science projects, volunteers and amateurs have helped make thousands of important scientific discoveries.
